gate_type: DESIGN / AUDIT ONLY gate (Issue #89): freeze the SH-WTP whole-plant simulation and control architecture plus the implementation sequence before any expansion coding. No source/runtime implementation, no UI implementation, no PIM mutation.
sa_decision_ref: Issue #89 (SA Task Contract, authoritative); required base f4dcca5 (UX01 CLOSED, verdict ASSY_STRUCTURE_UX_CONSISTENT)
architecture_authority_ref: Issue #78 (R0 frozen) + Issue #89 frozen architecture chain + accepted SH-WTP structural skeleton (G10/G11/G12B/G13/G13B/G14A/G14B/G15/G18/G21/G22)
objective: Produce the repo-first VF-SHW-X0 design report that freezes: (1) current SH-WTP asset/process/runtime inventory; (2) Area -> Process -> Unit mapping; (3) known/assumed/unknown topology matrix; (4) PIM-supported fidelity ceiling vs proposed VF synthetic/reference fidelity; (5) Deep Scope A (LINE1 downstream treatment, T106->T108 centered); (6) Deep Scope B (RAW WATER intake, T100 centered); (7) proposed Key Assets per deep scope; (8) whole-plant C0/C1/C2 control matrix; (9) proposed PI/PID loops (PV/SP/MV, limits, anti-windup, AUTO/MANUAL, permissive/interlock, synthetic tuning status); (10) process/state-variable contracts; (11) Frame A / Frame B UI information architecture; (12) refined X1..X7 gate sequence with dependencies and STOP assessment. Control truth must remain synthetic/reference with site_truth=false.
explicit_non_objectives: No source/runtime implementation of any kind
No PIM write and no PIM semantic/code change (escalate to PIM SA instead)
No gateway/protocol work (OPC UA, MQTT, Kafka)
required_smoke_checks: Canonical baseline green at the pushed head (design-only gate: no executable source change)
Full suite count unchanged from the accepted base f4dcca5 (2669 passed)
forbidden_actions: Writing to the PIM repository or mutating PIM semantics
Introducing a canonical PIM ID that does not already exist in the repo
Claiming site truth, site calibration or vendor/PLC-equivalent control
stop_conditions: A required PIM semantic or code change is necessary to complete the design (STOP FOR SA / PIM SA)
The frozen architecture would have to be reinterpreted or a second run authority introduced
A real product/architecture decision remains that cannot be resolved with a documented VF-assumed default

acceptance_criteria.description: All 12 required X0 deliverables present and repo-cited
No new canonical PIM ID invented (every canonical ID used by the design already exists in the repo)
Control truth frozen as synthetic/reference with site_truth=false and vf_runtime_authorization unchanged
Deep scopes A and B frozen with proposed Key Assets and C0/C1/C2/loop contracts
X1..X7 sequence validated/refined with dependencies and no reinterpretation of the frozen architecture
Design-only proof: no executable source change; baseline and full suite unchanged
